archetype: 3 (Pastel & Soft) mixed with 5 (Jewel & Luxury) - 'Soft Luxury' Aesthetic
mood: Premium, feminine but professional, editorial, elegant, high-end beauty brand

components.cards: White background, no hard borders or 1px subtle #F0EBE6 border. Use shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]. Generous p-8 padding. Use rounded-3xl.
components.buttons: Rounded-full. Primary: bg-[#2C2A29] text-white hover:bg-[#4A4745]. Secondary: bg-[#F7F3EE] text-[#2C2A29] hover:bg-[#E5DFD9]. Accent: bg-[#B8868B] text-white. Padding: px-6 py-3.
components.inputs: bg-[#F7F3EE] border-transparent focus:bg-white focus:border-[#B8868B] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#B8868B]. rounded-xl or rounded-full. py-3.
components.navigation: Sidebar or top nav with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80. Active links indicated by muted rose background or bold text with a subtle dot.
components.badges: Soft tinted backgrounds (e.g. bg-[#E8C5C8]/30 text-[#B8868B]) for status like Confirmed or Completed.
components.calendar: Soft UI. Hide heavy grid lines. Use subtle borders for days. Event blocks should have soft rounded corners (rounded-lg) and pastel backgrounds (blush, champagne, sage).
components.chat_bubble: Floating action button, bottom right. bg-[#2C2A29] text-[#E8C5C8] rounded-full shadow-2xl. Avatar inside using the image url provided.

motion.hover: transition-all duration-300 ease-out. Cards: -translate-y-1 shadow-lg. Buttons: scale-[1.02]
motion.page_load: Framer motion: initial={{opacity:0, y:10}} animate={{opacity:1, y:0}} transition={{duration:0.4, staggerChildren:0.1}}
motion.interactions: Smooth accordion expansions, modal popups with backdrop blur fade-in.

icons.style: stroke-1.5, minimalist, elegant. Use text-[#2C2A29] or text-[#9E948F].

pages_instructions.Dashboard: Bento grid layout. Top area: Greeting 'Good Morning, [Name]' with elegant serif. Key stats in clean rounded-3xl cards. Main area: 'Today's Schedule' timeline vs 'Quick Actions'. Use soft shadows.
pages_instructions.Calendar: Editorial calendar. Not generic full-calendar. Day/Week/Month tabs in a soft pill. Appointments are soft blocks of color (blush, sage, champagne) with stylist avatar and client name.
pages_instructions.Team: Masonry or clean grid. Large portrait photos using the staff media URLs. Very clean typography: Stylist Name (Serif), Role (Sans overline). Elegant 'Book' or 'View Schedule' hover action.
pages_instructions.Services: Categorized list or grid. Not clinical tables. Use expansive rows with generous padding. Service Name (bold serif), duration, dotted line or flex-grow space, Price (mono or serif).
pages_instructions.Reports: Sleek stat cards. Use Recharts with custom tooltips (rounded borders, soft shadows) and colors matching the brand palette (rose, taupe, charcoal). No harsh default blue lines.
pages_instructions.AI_Chat: Floating circular button with AI avatar. When clicked, opens a polished chat window with backdrop-blur. System messages in charcoal, user messages in muted rose.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on charcoal, and dark charcoal on champagne/blush backgrounds passes APCA.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-appointment-btn', data-testid='team-member-card').
